settings.title: Hyaluronic Acid
settings.text: Deeply hydrates and helps skin retain moisture for a plump, dewy look. It works by drawing water into the skin and holding onto it throughout the day, which is why hydration tends to look and feel more noticeable soon after applying. It's one of the most well-studied hydrating ingredients in skincare.

settings.title: Vitamin C
settings.text: Brightens and helps even the look of skin tone over time. With consistent use, it supports a more radiant, luminous-looking complexion. It works well alongside hydrating ingredients like Hyaluronic Acid rather than competing with them.

settings.title: Niacinamide
settings.text: Supports a smoother, more refined-looking texture. It's a gentle ingredient that pairs well with most skin types, including those prone to sensitivity. Over time, it helps skin look more balanced and even.

settings.title: Zero Fillers
settings.text: No harsh alcohols, sulfates, or synthetic fragrances. We keep the formula focused on ingredients that actually benefit your skin, not ones that just make it smell or feel a certain way temporarily. That means less risk of irritation and more consistent results.

settings.title: Step 1: Cleanse
settings.text: Start with clean, dry skin so the serum can absorb properly without being blocked by leftover makeup, oil, or product buildup. A gentle cleanser is all you need before applying.

settings.title: Step 2: Apply
settings.text: Apply 2-3 drops to face and neck, morning and night, gently pressing it into skin rather than rubbing. A little goes a long way, so there's no need to use more than a few drops per application.

settings.title: Step 3: Follow With Moisturizer
settings.text: Lock it in with your favorite moisturizer for best results, since this helps seal in the hydration the serum provides. Waiting a moment for it to absorb before applying moisturizer can help it layer more smoothly.

settings.description: Real transformations from customers who left a review.

settings.heading: How often should I use this?
settings.row_content: For best results, use it both morning and night after cleansing, as part of your regular skincare routine. Twice-daily use helps maintain consistent hydration throughout the day and supports the skin's natural repair process overnight. If you're new to serums, you can start with once a day and build up from there.

settings.heading: Will this work for sensitive skin?
settings.row_content: The lightweight formula is designed to be gentle, but we always recommend a patch test first if you have sensitive skin or are trying a new product for the first time. Apply a small amount to your inner arm and wait 24 hours before applying it to your face. If you notice any irritation, discontinue use and consult a dermatologist.

settings.heading: Can I use this with other products?
settings.row_content: Yes, it layers well under moisturizer and sunscreen as part of your regular routine. It's formulated to absorb quickly, so it won't interfere with the products you apply afterward. If you use other active ingredients like retinol, we recommend introducing them on alternating nights to avoid overloading your skin.

settings.heading: How soon will I see results?
settings.row_content: Many customers notice a visible glow within days, with continued improvement over 3-4 weeks of consistent use. Hydration-related benefits tend to show up quickly, while improvements in texture and tone take a bit longer to become noticeable. Using it consistently, both morning and night, gives you the best chance of seeing results.

settings.heading: A Glow-Up That Fits Your Routine

settings.text: Press a few drops into clean skin, morning and night, and let the lightweight formula do the rest. It absorbs quickly, layers easily under moisturizer or makeup, and never leaves a heavy or greasy residue behind. In just two minutes, it becomes one of the easiest steps in your entire routine — simple enough to stick with, effective enough to notice.

settings.caption: 01 — Formula
settings.heading: Hydration That Goes Deep
settings.text: Hyaluronic Acid draws moisture into the skin and helps it stay there throughout the day, while Niacinamide works alongside it to support a smoother, more even-looking texture and tone.
